definitions.explanation: The direction from which the wind is blowing. A technical term used in weather reports and meteorology; everyday speech uses {風向|かざむ}き, which also has the figurative sense 'the way things are going'.

examples.japanese: {風向|ふうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
{風向|ふうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦テント→テント：03859_tento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}ろう→張る：12583_haru⟧。
examples.english: Let's check the wind direction before pitching the tent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気予報|てんきよほう}→天気予報：01678_tenkiyohou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{風向|ふうこう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{風速|ふうそく}→風速：24554_fuusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the wind direction and wind speed in the weather forecast.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{風|ふう}→風：30892_fuu⟧ (wind) and {向|こう} (direction). The word {風向|かざむ}き (read かざむき) is the more common everyday form. {風向|ふうこう} alone is used in meteorological and technical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風向|ふうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: the wind direction changes
- {風向|ふうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to check the wind direction
- {風向|ふうこう}⟦{計|けい}→計：02691_kei⟧: wind vane; anemoscope
- {風向|かざむ}き: wind direction (the everyday word, read かざむき)

USAGE:
In its figurative sense, {風向|かざむ}き refers to the prevailing mood or trend of a situation, similar to the English expression "the way the wind blows."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{風速|ふうそく}→風速：24554_fuusoku⟧: wind speed — often mentioned alongside wind direction in weather reports
- ⟦{風力|ふうりょく}→風力：06432_fuuryoku⟧: wind force; wind power — the strength of the wind
- ⟦{方角|ほうがく}→方角：08447_hougaku⟧: direction; compass point — general directional orientation
